canonical_name: willemt/raft -- a C implementation of the Raft consensus algorithm
lineage: Raft (2014, Ongaro & Ousterhout): understandable distributed consensus -- leader election, log replication, and safety across crashing/partitioning nodes; willemt/raft is a widely-used embeddable C library of the core state machine
version: github.com/willemt/raft master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)
dependencies: a C compiler; the repo bundles its test deps
entry_points: the raft state machine (raft_periodic, raft_recv_appendentries, raft_recv_requestvote); make tests

example.input: the unit + fuzz tests of election and log replication

upstream_docs: Ongaro & Ousterhout, In Search of an Understandable Consensus Algorithm (Raft), USENIX ATC 2014

human_capability_summary.built_to: keep a replicated log consistent across a cluster of machines that crash, restart, and get partitioned -- by electing a leader and replicating entries only when a majority acknowledges
human_capability_summary.pressure: partial failure: nodes die, messages are lost or delayed, the network splits; the system must never present two leaders' conflicting histories as committed
human_capability_summary.success_means: a single consistent committed log despite up to (N-1)/2 failures; safety never violated, liveness restored when a majority reconnects

human_environmental_pressure: partial failure, message loss/delay, network partition, competing would-be leaders
human_failure_condition: split-brain: two leaders commit conflicting entries; the replicated state diverges and data is lost or corrupted
behavioral_entry_point: in the tests, drop/delay AppendEntries or RequestVote messages, or kill the leader, and watch election + log reconciliation

lineage_relations.note: Raft; itself a redesign of Paxos for understandability

nyx_handoff.how_to_run_it: recipe.json (runner docker); python -m techne.fossils.harvest run willemt-raft
nyx_handoff.what_humans_used_it_for: keep a replicated log consistent across a cluster of machines that crash, restart, and get partitioned -- by electing a leader and replicating entries only when a majority acknowledges
